rule: ROLE_GAP requires positive frozen evidence for a recurrent cognitive-system role that cannot be represented as an existing role, a claim-level relation semantic, a formal-carrier limitation, a derived structure, a source/context parameter, or an underdetermined modeling choice.

claims.rationale: Acquisition/retrieval condition identities remain scientifically meaningful beyond bare T indices, while the lane also retains O without frozen P_out. Neither fact establishes a ninth cognitive-system role.

foil_similarity_condition is a frozen generic condition rather than C/Q/Pi/P; O-to-O inferential/lower-bound topology exceeds direct rho. These are context/relation/carrier pressures, not a new top-level role.

Visual and haptic estimator-uncertainty condition nodes remain outside C under the frozen no-reinterpretation rule; they parameterize the claim rather than defining an independently recurring cognitive role.
Initial calibration and movement-duration conditions remain explicit; persistence is also underidentified because no carry/transport witness is frozen. Neither requires a primitive beyond v0.
task_relevance_condition survives as a generic claim parameter and cannot be promoted to Q/C without unsupported semantic strengthening.
Present/future context, context mismatch, and temporal-distance nodes are explicit contextual parameters. Their identities are not exhausted by T but do not constitute a recurrent system role.
Context constraint, feature overlap, contextual fit, and verbal fluency remain generic conditions; the one supported C role is separately frozen as adult_age_resource_profile.
strong_competing_alternative is a required contextual condition but is not frozen as C/Q/Pi/P/X.
prior_trial_context and current_distractor_compatibility are retained context carriers rather than new system roles.
task_transition and advance_preparation_opportunity remain conditions; change/repeat may later be derivable as K-over-T but no frozen derivation is currently licensed.

The crossed condition-indexed comparison and the evidential relation from observed dissociation to latent system interpretation are assertions about relations/evidence, not a missing system component.
Observation-to-latent estimation is an epistemic/model-inference relation. Current rho is forward readout, so the mismatch is relation language plus carrier directionality.
Frozen O-to-latent inference and incoming informational O are not represented by the current forward readout carrier; neither demonstrates a new cognitive role.
Observation-to-latent estimation and incoming informational O again exceed the current rho signature but remain epistemic/interface-direction semantics rather than a role gap.
Early and late phase condition identities survive beyond their T ordering, but C/Q/Pi/P are explicitly unsupported. They are indexed contexts, not a new role.
The frozen condition pair survives alongside Pi/P_out structure and cannot be absorbed into those roles; current Lean carrier is also narrower than the Discussion-level topology.
current_state and candidate_action are frozen generic conditions. A separate approximation-mode ambiguity remains underdetermined. Neither is evidence for a ninth role.

summary.interpretation: The residuals support separating the cognitive-system role grammar from a richer scientific claim/assertion language and from formal carrier engineering. They do not currently justify Grammar v1.
